verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a catalog of thousands of prebuilt, vendor-maintained app integrations. It only shows adjacent items: the custom-apps SDK (a developer building block for creating your own apps), generic webhooks, and API endpoints for listing connections. None of these shows a vendor-maintained connector ecosystem at the claimed scale.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations
